checks.scope: Each fresh image reports its injected failure and production boot refusal through serial_pd; guest capability setup and completed OS boot are not observed during the subsequent 500 ms check
Normal images without fault injection: host tests, both root-task architectures, ARM guest network/block/console

limits: Fault injection covers absent frame, invalid mapping destination and empty source capability; not exhaustive allocator exhaustion.
No recreation, runtime recovery or complete release qualification claim.
